services.serviceDescription:
Overview

This feature service contains cadastral mapping information for the Al Jmail area, supporting land administration and parcel reference workflows. It combines parcel geometry with associated ownership and registration attributes, along with supporting index and boundary-related layers.

Feature Layers
  • GRId_INDEX provides indexed reference information for the cadastral framework, including reference names and associated text labels used to organize map content.
  • SIDEWALK represents linear sidewalk features and includes editable GIS management fields.
  • PARCEL_BLOCKS represents block-scale parcel boundary geometry and includes editable GIS management fields.
  • PARCEL contains parcel polygons with cadastral attributes such as parcel number, map sheet number, owner name, classification, deed and document references, ownership date, file number, and parcel area details. It also includes editing task fields used for assignment, status, priority, due dates, notes, and descriptions.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Al Jmail cadastral area and supports local parcel and planning records within that jurisdiction.

Use Cases
  • Parcel and cadastral map maintenance
  • Land ownership and document reference management
  • Boundary and block reference mapping
  • Operational editing and task tracking for GIS workflows
